title: Rigid Gift Boxes: What Buyers Should Confirm Before Sampling
buyer_question: What should buyers confirm before sampling rigid gift boxes?
short_answer: Before sampling rigid gift boxes, buyers should confirm product dimensions, product weight, box opening style, insert structure, surface finish direction, artwork status and the sales channel. Rigid boxes are often judged by structure, feel and unboxing sequence, so sampling should review fit and protection before only reviewing color or foil details.
comparison_rows: Domestic factory sites expose product categories quickly
Overseas sites explain use cases and brand presentation
Use a structure comparison table on the MUGE rigid box page
Explain what sampling should review before price comparison
Use process notes and clear RFQ fields without unverified claims
competitor_signals: Jialan, Packoi and Pakoro show useful gift box/category signals; PakFactory and WestRock show stronger buyer education patterns.
